skills.title: Researching Body and Matter Topics
skills.description: Put the steps of a research in order. Pick a good question about the body, matter, or energy and the best place to find the answer.

skills.title: Fair Tests With Matter and Energy
skills.description: Pick the fair test that changes only one thing, like testing how fast ice melts. Put the steps of an experiment in order.

skills.title: Design, Build, Test Systems
skills.description: Put the steps for designing and building a device or structure in order. Pick what to change to make it work better.

skills.title: Staying Safe While Investigating
skills.description: Pick the safe way to use tools, heat, and materials. Choose the right gear to wear for the job.

skills.title: Sharing Findings for an Audience
skills.description: Pick the best way to share what you found for different people and reasons. Match science words to what they mean.

skills.title: Code That Stores Data
skills.description: Look at a few lines of code that store and use data, like a list or a variable. Pick what the code will do with the data.

skills.title: Coding, New Tech, and Skilled Trades
skills.description: Pick how coding and new technology change everyday life and jobs, including skilled trades.

skills.title: Science in Jobs and Subjects
skills.description: Match jobs, including skilled trades, to the science they use to fix real problems. Pick how science works with other subjects to help.

skills.title: Science Ideas From Many Communities
skills.description: Match science and technology ideas to the communities that gave them to us. Pick how those ideas help people.

skills.title: Body Systems and Their Jobs
skills.description: Pick the body systems, like digestive, breathing, and blood flow. Match each system to its main job.

skills.title: Vital Organs
skills.description: Label organs like the heart, lungs, stomach, and brain. Pick what each one looks like inside and what it does.

skills.title: Body Systems Work Together
skills.description: Pick how body systems team up, like lungs and heart getting oxygen to muscles.

skills.title: Diseases and Body Systems
skills.description: Match diseases and medical disorders, like asthma or diabetes, to the organs or body systems they affect.

skills.title: What Affects Our Health
skills.description: Pick how things around us, like clean air, sleep, and friends, help or harm health. Pick ways to cut the harm.

skills.title: Technology and Our Health
skills.description: Pick good and bad effects of technology on health, like helmets or too much screen time. Think about different points of view.

skills.title: Food Choices and Health
skills.description: Pick how knowing about food, like reading labels, helps you choose foods that are good for body and mind.

skills.title: What Is Matter?
skills.description: Pick that matter is anything that has mass and takes up space. Sort things that are matter from things that are not.

skills.title: Solids, Liquids, and Gases
skills.description: Sort things into solids, liquids, and gases. Pick how each one keeps or changes its shape and volume.

skills.title: Changes of State Around Us
skills.description: Pick changes of state you see at home and outside, like melting, freezing, evaporating, and condensing.

skills.title: Heat and Changes of State
skills.description: Pick how matter taking in or giving off heat makes it melt, freeze, boil, or condense.

skills.title: Physical Changes
skills.description: Sort changes of state, volume, or form, like cutting paper or dissolving sugar, that make no new substance.

skills.title: Chemical Changes and Signs
skills.description: Pick changes that make a new substance, like burning or rusting. Pick the signs, like gas bubbles, colour change, or new smell.

skills.title: Useful Properties of Matter
skills.description: Match properties of solids, liquids, and gases, like hardness or flowing, to the job they are good for.

skills.title: How Making Products Affects the World
skills.description: Pick how the steps used to make common products, like heating or mixing, affect people and nature.

skills.title: Materials and the Environment
skills.description: Pick how the materials in products affect nature. Pick actions people can take to lessen the harm.

skills.title: Forces Inside Structures
skills.description: Pick the forces inside a structure, like tension, compression, shear, and torsion. Pick what each one does to it.

skills.title: Forces Acting on Structures
skills.description: Pick outside forces on a structure, like wind, weight, and waves. Pick what they do to it.

skills.title: Structures Standing Up to Nature
skills.description: Pick how earthquakes, floods, and storms can harm buildings. Pick features and materials that help structures hold up.

skills.title: Plant and Animal Protection
skills.description: Match features of plants and animals, like turtle shells or bendy stems, to the forces they protect against.

skills.title: Protective Gear and Forces
skills.description: Match protective gear, like helmets and pads, to how it protects people from the force.

skills.title: Nature's Forces and Structures
skills.description: Pick how forces like wind, water, and quakes affect natural and built structures.

skills.title: Protecting Communities From Forces
skills.description: Pick ways people in cities, farms, and remote places lessen harm from natural forces, like sea walls and storm shutters.

skills.title: Forms of Energy
skills.description: Pick forms of energy like light, heat, sound, motion, and electrical. Match each to how we use it every day.

skills.title: Energy Is Never Lost
skills.description: Pick that energy can't be made or destroyed. It only changes from one form to another.

skills.title: Stored Energy and Transformations
skills.description: Pick where energy is stored, like in a stretched spring. Follow how it changes form in a device.

skills.title: Energy Escaping as Heat, Light, Sound
skills.description: Pick how some energy spreads out as heat, light, or sound when energy changes form, like a warm light bulb.

skills.title: Renewable and Non-Renewable Energy
skills.description: Sort energy sources, like wind, solar, coal, and oil, into renewable and non-renewable.

skills.title: Fossil Fuels and Climate Change
skills.description: Pick how burning fossil fuels adds gases to the air and how that warms the planet.

skills.title: Long-Term Effects of Using Energy
skills.description: Pick how long-term energy and resource use affects people and nature. Pick ways to lessen the harm.

skills.title: Technology That Saves Energy
skills.description: Pick how technologies, like smart thermostats and LEDs, use more or less energy. Pick ways to use tech to save energy.

skills.title: First Nations, Métis, Inuit Conservation
skills.description: Pick how First Nations, Métis, and Inuit communities use their knowledge to save energy and resources.
